verses.t: “Sabbaṁ, bhikkhave, anabhijānaṁ aparijānaṁ tattha cittaṁ avirājayaṁ appajahaṁ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya. Sabbañca kho, bhikkhave, abhijānaṁ parijānaṁ tattha cittaṁ virājayaṁ pajahaṁ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā”ti. Etamatthaṁ bhagavā avoca. Tatthetaṁ iti vuccati:
“Yo sabbaṁ sabbato ñatvā, sabbatthesu na rajjati; Sa ve sabbapariññā so, sabbadukkhamupaccagā”ti.
Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti. Sattamaṁ.
